criteria.text: Adults ≥ 18 years old.
Documented diagnosis of locally advanced (stage IIIB/IIIC) or metastatic (stage IV) non-small-cell lung carcinoma.
Prior treatment with a platinum-containing regimen.
Fewer than three prior regimens, counting maintenance as part of the preceding line.
PD-L1-positive tumor (TPS ≥ 1%) by a validated assay.
ECOG PS 0-1 within 2 weeks of screening.
Adequate bone marrow function within 28 days prior to screening: ANC >= 1.5 × 10^9/L, platelet count ≥ 100 × 10^9/L and Hb no less than 9 g/dL.
Calculated creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault) at least 50 mL/min in the 28 days before first dose.
Adequate liver function in the 14 days before first dose: AST and ALT <= 2.5 × ULN, and total bilirubin no more than 1.5 × ULN.
Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1.
reasons: no record can answer 'measurable disease (RECIST)': checked by the site at screening

Known interstitial lung disease.
Active autoimmune disease that required systemic treatment within 2 years before screening.
Known history of HIV infection.
